title: What If a Heat Dome Parked Over Your Town? One Did

scenes.text: What if a heat dome parked over your town? In 2021, one broke a national record.
On June 29, 2021, Lytton, British Columbia hit 49.6 degrees Celsius, the hottest temperature ever recorded in Canada.
The next day a wildfire started, and an MP estimated that about 90 percent of the village was destroyed.
Across the province, the coroner linked well over 500 deaths to that single week of heat.
About 69 percent of the dead were 70 or older, and 96 percent died at home.
The deadliest day was June 29, with 231 lives lost, the same day the record fell.
